Prestige Overview

Optional milestone progression

Prestige is an optional long-term progression milestone. Players can continue leveling, and prestige becomes available at level milestones for additional bonuses rather than acting as a hard progression wall.

500

Every 500 Levels

A new prestige level becomes available every 500 levels.

500 levels
10%

XP Curve

Experience gains decrease by 10% multiplicatively every 500 levels.

XP scaling
TOK

Prestige Token

Prestige Level-Up Token replaces the old Dungeon Medal and Awakening Wand requirements.

5,000 AP

03

How to Use Prestige

Practical guide
  • Treat prestige as a bonus progression milestone, not a forced cap.
  • Plan your timing around the level milestone and required payment items.
  • Expect experience gains to become slower at each 500-level bracket.
